source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-09. The table's own CA(32;3,88,2) (Power CT over GF(11), row S7) is doubled by the Roux construction with a 10-row strength-2 array, giving CA(42;3,176,2) (programs/roux176.py). No column can be added to that array as it stands (exact SAT check). The top 32 rows of its 176 columns are then kept fixed while the 10 bottom rows and 4 new columns are searched by simulated annealing with exact counts on all triples, starting from the Roux array with random new columns (programs/pad.py roux.txt 42 180 1 start.txt, then programs/ext3g.c, command ext3g top.txt 32 176 10 4 1 150 1.0 g180 -i start.txt -k 2, 0 uncovered at 127 s). Exact check with ca_verify, all 3-sets
construction: Roux doubling of the Power CT CA(32;3,88,2) with the 10 doubling rows re-searched together with 4 added columns, the top 32 rows fixed
notes: ties the cited size 42 at k = 180; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
